messages:
Zara: heads-up: customer reported overbilling after a midstream router eviction. looks like a tool output executed, but suffix never reached client and later replay charged again. can we triage ledger path?
Tom: can you paste the short trace?
Zara: redacted snippet: 
```
router: evict session=cli-99 reason=hot-shard-move seq=214
stream: truncated session=cli-99 truncated_tokens=28
toolcall: id=tc-314 status=ok out_tokens=18
router: fallback reconnect session=cli-99b resume_from=212
toolcall: id=tc-314 status=ok out_tokens=18 (replayed)
ledger: confirmed tenant=team-x tokens=36
```
Priya: we currently mark ledger entries confirmed on toolcall_done event. that's unsafe if client never saw the suffix (truncated).
Alex: agree. idea: mark toolcall token writes provisional and only flip to confirmed on a client_commit event (client ack or stream-end). also include a canonical_commit_id so replays dedupe.
Tom: implementation concerns: provisional writes multiply DB rows and increase write qps. maybe only provisionalize when the router reports a preemptive eviction or if the request is streaming=true.
Priya: telemetry requirements: count provisional_writes, provisional_confirms, provisional_rollbacks, duplicate_toolcall_hits. add a low-cardinality tag for rollout_flag.
Zara: console UX: request details should surface provisional tokens with an orange badge and a small timeline (toolcall -> provisional -> reconciled_at). allow filtering requests with provisional>0.
Alex: for dedupe we need canonical_toolcall_id in toolcall events. router must set canonical id even when replayed across session ids.
Tom: rollout plan: feature flag billing.provisional_tokens_v1. enable for internal tenants + 10% hosted; dedicated customers can opt in 100% immediately. canary on staging first.
Priya: also surface reconcile latency histogram in billing dashboard (p50/p95). ops wants alert if reconcile_p95 > 30s or duplicate_toolcall_ratio > 0.3% for 5m.
Zara: agree. docs: SDK contract changes for client to send explicit commit_ack when it receives end-of-response. need migration plan for older SDKs (they won't send commit_ack). fallback: treat client disconnects as no-ack and keep provisional until TTL.
Alex: data model sketch: provisional_ledger entries (tenant, canonical_commit_id, toolcall_id, tokens, state=provisional, created_at). reconcile job groups by canonical_commit_id, dedupes toolcall_id, writes aggregate to confirmed_ledger, emits reconcile_event. TTL 7d for stale provisional entries.
Tom: short-term stopgap: dedupe ledger writes when canonical_toolcall_id matches and token counts match within a window (1m). caveat: could hide legitimate retries. prefer provisional approach.
Priya: UI: tooltip: "provisional tokens may be reversed if stream truncated or request replayed. reconciled when client confirms receipt."
infra-bot: canary-deploy: queued branch z/prov-tokens. targets: staging-canary-2.
Alex: owners: Tom (ledger + reconcile), Zara (router events + canonical ids), Priya (console + telemetry), I'll own rollout and RFC.
Priya: timeline: RFC this week, proto router change by EOD Fri, reconcile worker PR next week, console changes after reconcile event schema stable.
Zara: repro steps to validate locally:
1) start router with small shard_move_interval
2) stream ~250 tokens with toolcall around seq 210
3) force router eviction midstream
4) reconnect client to other router that replays toolcall
Expected: single confirmed invoice after reconcile. Current: two confirmed.
Tom: will prototype append-only provisional table and run perf microbench.
Priya: will wire up dashboard panels and add alert.
billing-bot: note: invoicing pipeline consumes only confirmed_ledger; switching prevents provisional tokens from hitting invoices prematurely.
Zara: great. please drop any extra failure modes in the RFC. thanks all.
